title: SCOTUS Tells NFL It Won’t Review Brian Flores Race Case

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: SCOTUS Tells NFL It Won’t Review Brian Flores Race Case
sources.description: The U.S. Supreme Court on Monday denied a petition by the NFL, New York Giants, Denver Broncos and Houston Texans to review Minnesota Vikings defensive coordinator Brian Flores’ race-based employment discrimination lawsuit.
